title: focuser_primaluce read the calibrated range before the controller stored it after END
summary: CAL_MAXPOS keeps the previous value (0 or the previous calibration) for up to about 0.65 s after StoreAsMaxPos is acknowledged, so the driver refused moves as uncalibrated or published the position beyond a stale maximum.

resolution.evidence: 011-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md: END polls until the maximum changes and redefines the motion properties; sestosenso3_calibration passes and fails with the previous poll; hardware END published 30975.
